function.arguments: {"observation": "48 patient_id values are duplicated, meaning 48 patients were retested and appear in two rows. The data dictionary states that the row with the highest `sample_seq` supersedes earlier rows for that patient. This means we must deduplicate on `patient_id`, keeping the highest `sample_seq` per patient to avoid double-counting and double-weighting retested individuals.", "implication": "Any summary statistic computed over the raw data will be biased because retested patients are counted twice. We must deduplicate before computing the mean baseline biomarker value. Failure to do so would overcount retested patients and inflate the mean if their values differ."}
function.name: note_finding
